profile.headline: Software Developer Lead at Lynden
profile.summary:
- Certified SCJP and OCWCD with 22 years of solid experience in web-based and mobile application development using various Java/J2EE and Javascript technologies

- Senior Programmer with advanced proficiency in Java, J2EE, Ionic 5, Cordova, AngularJS, Angular 11, Spring Boot, Restful Web Services, JSP, Servlet, Struts, Google Web Toolkit (GWT), Spring, Hibernate, Java Persistence API (JPA), Messaging (Kafka, ActiveMQ, JMS), Javascript, HTML, CSS, XSL, XML, SQL, Web Services, DB2, MSSQL, OAuth2 Security, Keycloak, Okta Auth0 and Azure AD B2C security configuration among others. Also worked on projects that uses Docker, Kubernetes and Github Actions.

- Highly skilled with Model Driven Multi-Tier Architecture using Integrated Development Environments such as Rational Software Architect (RSA), Rational XDE, WebSphere Studio Application Developer (WSAD), Eclipse, IntellijIDEA and NetBeans

- Advanced knowledge in using code repository control configuration, build development tools, issue management and scrum management tools like Git, Tortoise SVN, IBM Rational ClearCase, ClearQuest, Rational Team Concert (RTC), CVS, VSS, Ant, Maven, Jenkins, Atlassian JIRA and Rally.

- Solid background on object-oriented programming, design and various J2EE design patterns. Involved in full software development life cycle (SDLC) using Agile SCRUM and CMM processes.

- Proven to easily and effectively adjust in diverse work environments and situations as well as quickly adapt with new technologies 

- Has a strong functional knowledge on Transportation, Banking, Investments, and Insurance

- Experience with onshore-offshore team development/coordination and has experience working in several countries including United States (State Farm – 3 years), Malaysia (Standard Chartered Bank - 6 months), and Turkey (IsBank - 3 months) for various Accenture projects. Have also worked in Malaysia as a consultant for CIMB Bank under APAR Technologies and was sent for training/work in Indonesia (3 months). Worked as a Senior Java Developer for Zurich Technology Services and has been assigned for 3 months in Sydney, Australia as part of project transition.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer/ IT Lead
positions.locationName: Tangerang, Indonesia and Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
positions.description:
Regional Transaction Banking is one of the projects for CIMB, Malaysia's second largest financial services provider. It is an upgrade for the existing BizChannel which is an online application servicing the corporate clients of the bank in four countries: Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia. This project is implemented using a SOA-based tool provided by Aprisma Indonesia called PrismaGateway and Primecash.
Responsibilities	:
- Acts as the point of contact between Project Team and GIOD-GT, ensuring all IT related matters within the project is well coordinated and transitioned smoothly.
- Advising the project team on technical matters
- Ensuring all GIOD-GT processes are complied and executed in order to achieve CIMB group’s IT control and governance
- Identifying, monitoring, tracking and responding to technical risks
- Identifying, monitoring, tracking and escalating technical issues
- Assisting the Project Manager to keep the project on track in terms of schedule and budget with relation to GIOD-GT matters
- Ensuring technical project documentation is generated and kept up-to-date

- Part of the integration development doing the middleware and web services among different systems (LDAP, HSM, 8i, FSG, Murex, MEPS, Alltel) and also web application development (CIMB BizChannel) using JSP, Struts, Spring and Hibernate
- Travelled to Tangerang, Indonesia for business travels and trainings to learn Aprisma Application, Business Rules Engine and Integration Development
- Troubleshooting, debugging and resolving bugs and defects of CIMB Banking Application - System Integration Test for Malaysia

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project & Role Description

BIC is a time-sensitive US project for one of the world's largest personal insurance carriers that Accenture is currently engaged in, State Farm. State Farm is one of the top three Property and Casualty insurers in North America. In addition to being a leader in Property and Casualty Insurance, they offer a wide selection of other Financial Services products. Other product offerings include Banking, Mutual Funds and Life Insurance. They have over 70,000 employees and 17,000 exclusive agents.
	Temporary transferred in Accenture US for 3 yrs to work as a senior developer for State Farm. 
	Supervising 3 developers and also coached one developer which is a new comer in the team.
	Responsible for creating impact analysis
	Troubleshooting, debugging and resolving defects
	Implementing model and code modifications or enhancements
	Completing and executing unit test cases
	Conducting build/design peer reviews
	Working on application security and performance customizations
	Participating in knowledge transfer sessions and assisting fellow developers or client team members with design and development questions related to the ECS application.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
IsBank Project & Role Description

IsBank is Turkey's privately-owned bank with the highest gross profit and the first national bank of the Turkish Republic. It also has the most extensive branch network of any privately-owned bank in Turkey. Accenture Manila Delivery Center has committed to deliver the application to be used by the bank with the help of Accenture Turkey. 
Responsible for fixing defects, troubleshooting and debugging application system errors and implementing change request or enhancements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Meridea Project & Role Description

The project is composed of a preparatory team which is working on the training presentations and documentations of different project specific tool installations, server configurations and application development environment setup.
Responsible for creating the documentations of BEA WebLogic 8.1 Configuration Guide for Oracle - Best Practice and BEA WebLogic 8.1 Configuration Guide for Oracle v.01. 
One of the contributors in Meridea Framework Training Presentation. 
Involved in migration of scripts to different database - DB2 and Oracle. 
Tested three Meridea application baselines to different platforms (WebLogic - DB2, WebLogic - Oracle, WebSphere - DB2, and Websphere - Oracle).

positions.description:
IsBank Project & Role Description

IsBank is Turkey's privately-owned bank with the highest gross profit and the first national bank of the Turkish Republic. It also has the most extensive branch network of any privately-owned bank in Turkey. Accenture Manila Delivery Center has committed to deliver the application to be used by the bank with the help of Accenture Turkey.

Responsibilities include design and build of application use cases or modules. 
Accounted for analyzing and providing resolution to issues raised.
Conducted peer design and code reviews. 
Implemented code enhancements and testing fixes
Performed component and assembly test scripts and execution. 
Involved in value object creation and unit testing with the use of xml stub testing and

Tasked to conduct component test plan and source code peer review to ensure consistency with the requirements and compliance with project standards and processes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Meridea Project & Role Description

Meridea is a leading Mobile and online self-service software provider, specializing in mobile banking solutions. Meridea's software solutions deliver improved customer satisfaction, brand loyalty, and sales. Its clients include Standard Chartered Bank and Citic Industrial Bank and its solutions are currently being implemented by global banks in Asia and in Europe to achieve genuine competitive differentiation. Meridea's client in Malaysia is embarking on the implementation of Internet and Mobile Banking using their standard platform based on Meridea Product Suites solution. Meridea Financial Software requested Meridea Application Suite (MAS) service project work for their client in Malaysia (Meridea Services) to be done by Accenture under the terms and conditions of the Consultancy Services Agreement between Accenture Oy and Meridea Financial Software Oy. 
One of the developers assigned to Malaysia as a developer for six months to work for Standard Chartered Bank. 
Responsibilities include impact analysis and estimation, 
Design and build of application use cases, 
Analyze and provide resolution to issues raised, 
Conduct peer design and code reviews, 
Perform unit and assembly testing. 
Build design and codes of SMS Banking functionalities of the application
Support the Smart Client Mobile Banking Activation functionality of the application. 
Responsible for fixing defects identified during system integration test
